integrity: All mathematical statements follow from an exact block probability, a fixed-order Bell-ratio limit, and mixed factorial moments; the standalone enumeration is only a finite check. Historical priority remains qualified by partial access to some older sources.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive integer block sizes r>=2; no rate, finite-n independence, growing-size theorem or moment convergence. The date is the first publicly posted version of the probability-primary source arXiv:1610.07664, not the date of this finding.
title: Two distinct endpoint scales for size-marked block minima in uniform set partitions
